lesson: Configure the HTTP client retry policy to retry all 5xx status codes plus only 429 and 408 from 4xx, rejecting the proposal to retry only 5xx errors.
why: Retrying 401 caused account lockouts, while 429 allows recovery from burst rate-limits and 408 handles edge request timeouts.
quote: There are exactly two 4xx codes we MUST keep retrying: 429, because the upstream rate-limits in bursts and backs off fine, and 408

lesson: Cap total HTTP client attempts to 4, rejecting unlimited retry attempts.
why: Failures extending beyond 4 attempts require human intervention rather than continuing to hammer services.
quote: cap the whole thing at 4 attempts total. Past that we page a human instead.

lesson: Set the backoff ceiling to 30 seconds instead of the previous 60 seconds.
why: The gateway load balancer drops idle connections at 32 seconds, causing retries sleeping longer than 30 seconds to resume on a dead connection.
quote: The gateway load balancer kills idle connections at 32s, so any sleep past 30 just resumes onto a dead connection.
